cur:objects-leipzig-grassi-crucifixion-i.summary: Beneath an arch, Christ hangs on the cross with a large halo, his head bowed and his long body gently swaying; the Virgin raises her hand in grief at the left, while St John stands at the right, his hand to his cheek. The restrained composition gives the Crucifixion the stillness of an icon.
facts: Byzantine crucifixion ivories of the later 10th century often show Christ's body in a gentle curve with the head inclined in death, a type that spread to the West (type).
